seo.title: South America Gap Year Semester Program | Pacific Discovery
seo.description: Peru, Ecuador & the Galápagos in 10 weeks: Machu Picchu via the Inca Jungle Trail, Spanish immersion, Andean community volunteering and Galápagos snorkeling. Ages 17–22.

hero.eyebrow: Gap semester · Peru, Ecuador & the Galápagos
hero.headline: Machu Picchu, the Andes and the Galápagos in one semester

itinerary.heading: Week by week
itinerary.note: This is a guide to what you can expect to do on program. The order in which activities occur might vary.

weeks.title: Community volunteering & Spanish immersion
weeks.body: Meet your instructors in Lima and fly together to Cusco, then travel to Urubamba in the Sacred Valley for orientation. Explore the ruins of Pisaq, Ollantaytambo and Moray, start a community service project, and begin Spanish lessons at two levels.
weeks.imageAlt: Community volunteering in the Sacred Valley

weeks.title: Inca Jungle Trail & Machu Picchu
weeks.body: A 4-day journey to Machu Picchu: biking, optional zip-lining, natural hot springs and river traverses on the way to Aguas Calientes. Hike up for sunrise at Machu Picchu, with the option to climb Huayna Picchu.

weeks.title: Culture, cuisine & llamas in the Sacred Valley
weeks.body: A Cusco legend and culture tour, a farmers market visit and cooking class, then our second volunteer project with founders Alejandra and Jorge — recovering the traditional use and breeding of carrier llamas, with a day-trek alongside them.
